channel.title: Oil, gas & power · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Oil, gas & power in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.4).

item.title: [+1] Brent slips $1.17 to $103.60, a second daily fall, as Qatari mediators await US and Iranian replies
item.description:
Prices swung between $100.80 and $107.24 on strike headlines. Iran rejects 'diplomacy based on coercion'. Down about $14 from Friday's six-month high. Easing.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Cheaper crude

Why it matters: Crude near $104 eases India's import bill, inflation and rupee pressure compared with October.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +1, Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: high · horizon: days

item.title: [−1] US carries out limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island after Iranian fire on US aircraft
item.description:
Target was a missile launcher; the US says it is not a return to major combat. Iran warns of stronger retaliation and says Hormuz stays shut; the US president says no talks are planned. Mixed with diplomacy.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Supply risk

Why it matters: Strikes near Hormuz keep a risk premium in oil and threaten the diplomacy that has pushed crude down, a key swing factor for Indian markets.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] Rupee gains 13 paise to 94.71 per dollar on foreign inflows and the equity rally
item.description:
Reverses Monday's 10-paise fall. Lower oil and foreign buying support the currency. Strengthening.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Cheaper imports

Why it matters: A firmer rupee reduces imported inflation and the cost of oil, while modestly trimming exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] Iranian lawmaker says ships from India, China, Iraq and Qatar are exempt from Hormuz transit restrictions
item.description:
Comes as India engages the US on Hormuz security. Not confirmed by Iran's government; Iran also says the strait stays shut until the blockade ends. New, unverified.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Supply access

Why it matters: If applied, exemptions could restore some Indian-bound oil and LNG flows, easing supply and freight costs.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
